_comment: Gallery wall labels. Edit titles / years / medium here - js/world/museum.js reads this file at boot and nothing else hardcodes the text. `slug` keys the image files in this folder (<slug>.webp for inspect mode, <slug>_512.webp for the wall texture). `wall` and `at` place the work inside the museum; see docs/MUSEUM.md. The titles are the game's invention; the medium is what the works are, graphite on paper; the date is not known to us, so the plaques read Undated rather than assert a year about somebody else's work.
